the most common data mining techniques used in data stream mining are classification and clustering and the most common data stream mining challenges are concept drifting, high speed and limited memory.

the classification and evaluation of data stream mining techniques and their application to the data stream requirements.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
data streams' applications are not a new challenge in data mining.
the most important challenges of data mining techniques in data stream mining are the need of incremental learning and the need of fast mining methods.
the most important data mining techniques that have been applied to data streams are clustering, classification, outlier detection, and frequent pattern mining.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have analyzed and categorized related researches for data stream mining.
the classification of data mining techniques and data stream challenges can help researchers to select proper techniques for different data stream applications.
this article provides a classification of data mining techniques based on their application to data stream mining.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the data stream mining is a very broad and active area of research.
the current data stream mining researches have focused on the data stream mining challenges, and they have not paid much attention to the data stream mining requirements.
the existing techniques for data stream mining have been categorized in a framework and their advantages and disadvantages have been described in detail.
